stage1.impression: A clean, legible interiors render: the spectrum bar front makes a strong diagonal, and the coloured back-bar repeats it. It still reads as CG. The panels are flat emissive cards with bright seam lines, the floor is a smeared, denoised mottle that barely picks up the panels' colour, every stool is the same model, and the back-bar and the pink ceiling compete with the hero. The cropped stool at bottom left and the half-cut pendant at top left make it feel unedited.

blocking_9: The bar panels must read as back-lit cast acrylic, with a soft vertical gradient and depth rather than flat uniform emission (red panel lum_range under its top 5/8 now about 8)
The joints between panels must not show bright 1 px white light-leak lines (now lum_median 186 at x 182-186)
The floor must read as a real honed or polished dark surface that carries soft coloured reflections of the eight panels, with no denoiser blotching
The panels must be clearly the brightest, most saturated element; the back-bar shelves and the ceiling membrane must sit at least a stop below them
No cut-off foreground stool and no pendant cropped by the frame edge; a composed edge on every side
Visible variation and a believable oiled-wood sheen across the stools, so they do not read as one instanced model
Atmosphere: a little haze to give depth from the bar to the lounge and soft glow around the Bell pendants

defects.what: Bright white 1 px line at the red/orange panel joint, a light leak (lum_median 186 against a panel at about 80)
Same bright seam at the orange/yellow joint (p95 226)
Red panel is perfectly flat emission (top 5/8 bins 74-82); reads as a coloured card, not lit acrylic
Floor is a smeared, mottled denoise texture with no clear reflection of the panels; reads as CG concrete
Floor in front of the blue panel shows almost no blue spill (b_median 21)
Foreground stool cut by the left and bottom edges, a distracting dark mass
Bell pendant cropped by the top-left frame edge, with a hot clipped highlight (clip 0.42%)
Unclear dark box and white arc at the left edge (screen or appliance) that reads as clutter
Ten identical stools, same rotation and same wood; obvious instancing
Edge-lit shelves with white backs nearly as bright as the panels (p95 180), a second rainbow competing with the hero
Pink-lilac ceiling membrane bright and flat (lum_median 119), pulling the eye to the top right
Lounge chairs read low-detail, with a muddy orange-brown upholstery
Bar top stone reads flat dark grey with almost no specular from the pinholes; glasses barely read

changes.problem: The floor reads as a smeared CG mottle and does not reflect the panels, so the hero has no ground and the room no polish.

evidence.measured: lum_median 20, b_median 21 in front of the blue panel; floor lum_range 64 over 450-1200 x 600-800 with blotchy low-frequency noise

change.to: honed dark charcoal terrazzo or polished concrete, base colour about #2a2826, roughness 0.22, fine 2-4 mm aggregate texture at real scale, no large blotches

changes.expected: Soft vertical coloured streaks of each panel on the floor under the bar, fading to about 1.5 m out; the floor tone takes on each panel's hue in front of it.

changes.problem: The panel joints glow as bright white hairlines, which reads as a light leak and as a render.

evidence.measured: lum_median 186 against neighbouring panels at 80 and 118; edge step 86 over 1 px

change.setting: the joint or edge finish between bar panels
change.from: lit or clear edge showing white
change.to: matte black anodised reveal (or opaque black edge paint on the acrylic edges) so the joint reads as a dark 3-4 mm shadow line

changes.expected: Joints read as thin dark lines between the colours, darker than either neighbour.

changes.problem: Each panel is uniformly emissive, so it reads as a flat coloured card, not light passing through tinted cast acrylic.

evidence.measured: vertical profile bins 73.9, 78.5, 81.2, 81.6, 82.0: under 10 levels of variation

change.to: 0.6 at the top edge falling to about 0.4 at the foot (a vertical gradient as from an LED line at the top), plus a faint internal diffusion texture so the acrylic shows depth

changes.expected: Each panel brighter under the stone top and softly darker toward the plinth, by about 25-35% top to bottom.

changes.problem: The back-bar shelves form a second, almost equally bright rainbow that competes with the panels.

evidence.measured: p95 180, brighter than every panel's median (80-146); clip 0.1%

changes.expected: The back-bar recedes into a warm glow behind the bottles, about a stop under the panels, and the bottles read as silhouettes with rim light.

changes.problem: The pink ceiling membrane is a large, bright, flat area at the top right that pulls the eye away from the bar.

evidence.measured: lum_median 119, r_median 152 vs b 114 (a lilac-pink cast)

change.to: 0.01, clock set to a later, dimmer night setting

changes.expected: The ceiling falls to a dim warm field, letting the pendants and panels lead.

changes.problem: The first stool is cut by the frame at bottom left and a pendant is cropped at top left, so the edges look unedited.

evidence.measured: a dark partial stool mass at the frame corner; pendant at 0-110 x 0-100 clipped, clip 0.42%

change.to: position [1.2, 4.2, 1.2], lens 32 mm, same target [6.8, 8.2, 0.65]; frame so the first full stool sits clear of the left edge and no pendant touches the top edge

changes.expected: The bar front runs in from the left edge as a clean diagonal, with the first whole stool as the foreground anchor and the pendants fully inside the frame.

changes.problem: The stools are visibly one instanced model at one rotation, with a dull, plasticky wood.

evidence.measured: ten identical stools; seat tops median lum about 21 with no specular

change.to: oiled walnut, roughness 0.35 with clear-coat 0.3, per-stool hue and roughness jitter of plus or minus 5%, each stool rotated by a random 0-12 degrees and offset by plus or minus 15 mm on its spot

changes.expected: Each seat catches a soft coloured highlight from the panel behind it, and the row reads as real furniture.

changes.problem: The air has no depth: the lounge and the pendants sit flat behind the bar, and the bar top stone gives no sheen to carry the glasses.

evidence.measured: bar top lum_median 77 with few specular points; no visible glow volume around the Bell pendants

change.setting: haze in the room's air density; bar-top pinholes

changes.expected: Faint cones under the pinholes and soft halos on the Bells, the lounge stepping back in tone, and small pools of light on the stone around each glass.

out_of_scope.request: Show an Atmosphere speaker or a Cumulus in this frame to tie the bar to EARF's products
out_of_scope.why: This is a composition and layout choice about which products are placed in view; the room layout is fixed, so it is the owner's call

out_of_scope.request: Fewer stools, or a different stool design
out_of_scope.why: The stools belong to the room's proposed layout, which is fixed
